blocks.text: Cricket update: England ease to big victory as Sri Lanka crumble in first ODI. England maintain their excellent one-day form in a comfortable victory against Sri Lanka, as Will Jacks' stars with bat and ball to help the home side to an 89-run win at Chester-le-Street in the first ODI.
